svg.title: Permafrost carbon compared with the atmosphere
svg.desc: Bars in billions of tonnes of carbon: permafrost-region soils 1,300 to 1,600, of which about 800 is permanently frozen; the whole atmosphere in 2024 about 900. The IPCC projects 3 to 41 billion tonnes of carbon released as CO2 per degree of warming by 2100, with low confidence.
svg.text: Where the carbon is: permafrost soils against the air
Billions of tonnes of carbon (GtC). Permafrost region from NOAA and Hugelius et al.; atmosphere from the Global Carbon Budget 2025.
Even a fraction of the frozen store, released as CO₂ and methane, would make a large dent in the remaining carbon budget.
IPCC AR6: 3–41 billion tonnes of carbon released as CO₂ per °C of warming by 2100 (low confidence).
